name: ModYu
voice: Design Lab North have the pleasure of rebuilding ModYu — a calmer home for people before, during, and after hair transplant. Their current site is already out in the world; this plot is the facelift that should feel like them.

name: Swarm Fund
voice: Design Lab North have the pleasure of building Swarm Fund — a hive for cultural discovery and collective backing. The mark is here while the site is still being made. It will live on this greenhouse when it is ready to host; it is not a public site yet.

name: Choozlist
voice: Design Lab North have the pleasure of building Choozlist — a social gifting platform with a brain for lists. It already has its own server and will stay there. The greenhouse holds the work, not the host.
